name: manifestlens-monorepo
description: Explains Kubernetes YAML in plain English and flags risky settings. Local-first and offline.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @manifestlens/core && npm run build -w manifestlens && npm run build -w @manifestlens/web && npm run build -w manifestlens-vscode && npm run build -w @manifestlens/action
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
